wiki.title: Catherine Blakespear
wiki.extract: Catherine Smith Blakespear (née Blake; born February 29, 1976) is an American politician and former journalist who is currently serving in the California State Senate. She is a Democrat representing the 38th Senate District, which encompasses parts of Northern San Diego County and Southern Orange County.
